title: Muya Maler Winj Alamwa
stanzas: Muya Maler, winj alamwa. Mondo idag e chunywa;
Gi tekoni duto ilor, Muya Maler, ibi.
Bi kaka ler! Mond' ifwenynwa Kethwa, Kitwa maricho;
Mond' itelnwa e yor ngima, En yor jo mabeyo.
Bi kaka mach, ipwodh chunywa, Kuom gik maricho duto;
Mondo wachiwre ni Ruodhwa, Misango mangima.
Bi kaka koth, mi igwedhwa, Ka pod wan nyimi kae;
Dak ipong'wa gi tekoni, Kiloyo chunywa chuth.
Kaka yamo mondo ibi, Gi teko kaka chon cha;
Mondo warruok man kuom Yesu, Olandre piny duto.
